I saw people were asking why I made the characters happy, even if it was out of character for them. I just like seeing them happy, so sorry if it breaks the immersion for you.

What characters were you surprised to see, and what characters do you wish you saw more of? The whole reason I've been doing Arknights characters is I've always wanted more content of them.

I'm using an old 1660 graphics card, so each generation takes a long time. Each generation takes about 5 minutes each, and that's not counting regens and inpainting. This took me over a week, but I'm happy with the results I got.

I might take a break on posting for a while, but let me know what characters you'd like to see me try!
